# 0. Load libraries and data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
theme_set(theme_bw())

# Morphotraits and other sample information
uvp6_de_side <- read.table("../../Laval-imaging-analysis/UVP6_darkedge/ecotaxa_export_5108_20241018_1521.tsv", sep = '\t', header = TRUE)
uvp6_de_top <- read.table("../../Laval-imaging-analysis/UVP6_darkedge/ecotaxa_export_5108_20241018_1518.tsv", sep = '\t', header = TRUE)
# Only "Calanus" so far
uvp6_amund <- read.table("../../Laval-imaging-analysis/UVP6_amundsen2023/Calanus/ecotaxa_export_10101_20250117_1943.tsv",sep = '\t', header = TRUE)
# filter columns?

uvp6_meta <- bind_rows(uvp6_de_side, uvp6_de_top, uvp6_amund) %>% 
  filter(img_rank == 100)
rm(uvp6_de_side, uvp6_de_top,uvp6_amund)

# Lipid and prosome segmentation information
prosome_uvp6 <- read.csv("data/prediction_results_uvp6_20250311.csv",
                         header = TRUE)
lipid_uvp6 <- read.csv("data/prediction_results_uvp6deamund_lipid.csv",
                         header = TRUE)

# For now, work on images both with prosome and lipid and the annotated values
uvp6_seg <- lipid_uvp6 %>% 
  select(filename, lipid_pixels_annotated) %>% 
  left_join(prosome_uvp6 %>% 
              select(filename, prosome_pixels_annotated, 
                     prosome_major_annotated, prosome_minor_annotated),
            by = "filename") %>% 
  mutate(lipid.lf.area = lipid_pixels_annotated/prosome_pixels_annotated*100) %>% 
  # only select the Dark Edge 2021 for now
  mutate(object_id = str_remove(filename,".png")) %>% 
  filter(object_id %in% uvp6_meta$object_id)
rm(prosome_uvp6, lipid_uvp6)

# The volume per 5m bin information from ECOPART
uvp6_de_ecopart <- read.table("../../Laval-imaging-analysis/ECOPART/export_reduced_20250311_16_52_darkedge2021/export_reduced_20250311_volumes.tsv",  header = TRUE, sep = "\t") %>% 
  # Rename sample_id and Depth_5m to clearly specify bin size
  rename(sample_id = Profile, Depth_5m = Depth_m) %>% 
  select(sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_L)
uvp6_amund_ecopart <- read.table("../../Laval-imaging-analysis/ECOPART/export_reduced_20250311_16_40_Amudsen2023/export_reduced_20250311_volumes.tsv",  header = TRUE, sep = "\t") %>% 
  rename(sample_id = Profile, Depth_5m = Depth_m) %>% 
  select(sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_L)

# Match sample to volume (+- 2.5)
uvp6_meta <- uvp6_meta %>% 
  mutate(Depth_5m = floor(object_depth_min / 5)*5+2.5) %>% 
  left_join(bind_rows(uvp6_de_ecopart,uvp6_amund_ecopart),
            by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_5m)) %>% 
  # convert volume in L to m3
  mutate(Sampled_volume_m3 = Sampled_volume_L * 0.001)

rm(uvp6_de_ecopart, uvp6_amund_ecopart)

# TODO something wrong in the data here because total copepod abundance can be zero from the aggregated information but there are images for the depth bins!
# # for copepoda fractions of abundance and biomass in 50m bins
# "export_reduced_20250311_copepoda_fraction.tsv"
uvp6_de_ecopart_cope <- read.table("../../Laval-imaging-analysis/ECOPART/export_reduced_20250311_16_52_darkedge2021/export_reduced_20250311_copepoda_fraction.tsv",  header = TRUE, sep = "\t") %>% 
  # Rename sample_id and Depth_5m to clearly specify bin size
  rename(sample_id = Profile, Depth_25m = Depth_m) %>%  
  # convert volume in L to m3
  mutate(Sampled_volume_m3 = Sampled_volume_L * 0.001)
uvp6_de_ecopart_cope[is.na(uvp6_de_ecopart_cope)] <- 0
# weighted average for 50 m intervals for "Copepoda" abundance and biovolume
uvp6_ecopart_50m <- uvp6_de_ecopart_cope %>% 
  mutate(Depth_50m = floor(Depth_25m / 50)*50+25) %>% 
  mutate(Copepoda_biovolume_mm3_m3 = Copepoda_biovolume_mm3_l / 0.001) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, Depth_50m) %>% 
  summarise(cope_abundance_m3 = weighted.mean(Copepoda_abundance_m3, Sampled_volume_m3),
            cope_biovolume_mm3_m3 = weighted.mean(Copepoda_biovolume_mm3_m3, Sampled_volume_m3),
            .groups = "drop")
  
```

# Useful equations
Device image resolutions:
LOKI 23 um/0.023 mm
UVP5 125 um/ 0.125 mm
UVP6 84 um/0.084 mm
area (mm^2) = pixel_area * res(mm)^2

Convert area to total lipids (mg): 0.197 Area (mm2) ^ 1.38 (Vogedes et al. 2010)
total lipid (mg) to carbon (mg C) conversion factor: Lambda = 0.81 (Kattner & Graeve 1991); which is actually from this equation C2L <- (36*12) / (36*12 + 2*36 + 2*16)

Biovolume (mm3) to biomass (mgC)
From McConville et al. (2016):
- C. finmarchicus female 0.1473
- C. glacialis female 0.1177
- C. hyperboreus 0.1902
- M. longa female 0.1077

In Dubois et al. (2022):
"correction is around -20% for the ESD method and +10% for the ellipse method"

Potential diapause duration (Schmid et al. 2018)

In Jonasdottir et al. (2019) for C. finmarchicus:
Prosome Volume (mm3) = 0.0292 × Prosomelength(mm)^3.6699 (Miller et al. 2000)
DW = 0.0106 × ProsomeLength^3.64 
Carbon mass = 0.623 × DW − 0.0143 (Ingvarsdóttir et al. 1999)

TODO add Lucie's method
data['prosome_carbon_area'] = (data["prosome_area_mm2"] - data['lipid_area_mm2']) * 0.2 * 0.45 # Ikeda et al., 1989

# 1. Calculate prosome and lipid biomass in DW and carbon
```{r}
# Conversion factor to get lipid mg C from TL
lambda <- (36*12) / (36*12 + 2*36 + 2*16)
# Conversion factor to get biomass (mg C) from biovolume (mm3)
vol2massC <- mean(c(0.14373,0.1177,0.1902)) # average of 3 species

# Calculate lipid area in mm and biomass in total lipid (mg) and mg C
uvp6_seg <- uvp6_seg %>% 
  mutate(lipid_area_mm2 = lipid_pixels_annotated * 0.084 * 0.084,
         prosome_area_mm2 = prosome_pixels_annotated * 0.084 * 0.084) %>% 
  mutate(lipid_mass_mg = 0.197 * (lipid_area_mm2 ^ 1.38)) %>% 
  mutate(lipid_mass_mgC = lipid_mass_mg * lambda)

# Are prosome pixel area and the morphotrait area (in pixels) strongly correlated?
# Yes, and the annotated prosome has a lower area value than the ellipsoid area
uvp6_seg <- uvp6_seg %>% 
  left_join(
    uvp6_meta %>% 
      select(object_id, 
             Major = object_major, Minor = object_minor, Area = object_area),
    by = "object_id")

summary(lm(prosome_pixels_annotated ~ Area, data = uvp6_seg))
ggplot(uvp6_seg, aes(x = Area, y = prosome_pixels_annotated)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline()

# How about the major and minor axes from Ecotaxa vs the segmented prosomes
# Surprisingly the fits are not that strong with major axis R = 0.86 and minor axis R = 0.69.
# For the most part, the ecotaxa values are often larger, especially for the minor axis.
summary(lm(prosome_major_annotated ~ Major, data = uvp6_seg))
ggplot(uvp6_seg, aes(x = Major, y = prosome_major_annotated)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline()

summary(lm(prosome_minor_annotated ~ Minor, data = uvp6_seg))
ggplot(uvp6_seg, aes(x = Minor, y = prosome_minor_annotated)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline()


# Calculate prosome biovolume (mm3) and mass in mg and mg C, then calculate lipid fullness by mass
# A. Biovolume from 4/3*pi*(Major*Minor*Minor) and biomass from biovolume, not the best approach since LF can be > 100%, i.e. the prosome biomass calculated is smaller
uvp6_seg <- uvp6_seg %>% 
  # Use major and minor axis from Ecotaxa morphotrait
  mutate(biovolume_mm3_morphotrait = 4/3 * pi * (Major/2 * 0.084) * ((Minor/2 * 0.084)^2)) %>% 
  mutate(biomass_mgC_biovol_morphotrait = biovolume_mm3_morphotrait * vol2massC) %>% 
  mutate(LF_mgC_biovol_morphotrait = lipid_mass_mgC / biomass_mgC_biovol_morphotrait * 100) %>% 
# B. Use major and minor axis from segmented prosome. Less likely to have fullness > 100%
  mutate(biovolume_mm3_annotated = 4/3 * pi * (prosome_major_annotated/2 * 0.084) * ((prosome_minor_annotated/2 * 0.084)^2)) %>% 
  mutate(biomass_mgC_biovol_annotated = biovolume_mm3_annotated * vol2massC) %>% 
  mutate(LF_mgC_biovol_annotated = lipid_mass_mgC / biomass_mgC_biovol_annotated * 100) %>% 
# C. Use Lucie's method of calculating the minor axis as area/major then get biovolume
    mutate(minor_derived = (prosome_pixels_annotated / 
            (pi * prosome_major_annotated/2)) * 2) %>% 
  
  mutate(biovolume_mm3_annotderived = 4/3 * pi * (prosome_major_annotated/2 * 0.084) * ((minor_derived/2 * 0.084)^2)) %>% 
  mutate(biomass_mgC_biovol_annotderived = biovolume_mm3_annotderived * vol2massC) %>% 
  mutate(LF_mgC_biovol_annotderived = lipid_mass_mgC / biomass_mgC_biovol_annotderived * 100) %>% 
  
# D. Use prosome length to volume (mm3) and calculate dry weight and mg C (Jonasdottir et al. 2019 for C. finmarchicus)
  mutate(prosome_volume_Jonasdottir = 0.0292 * (prosome_major_annotated* 0.084)^3.6699,
         prosome_dryweight_Jonasdottir = 0.0106 * (prosome_major_annotated* 0.084)^3.64,
         prosome_mgC_Jonasdottir = 0.623 * prosome_dryweight_Jonasdottir - 0.0143)


# Compare the Jonasdottir estimates with the segmented estimates
# Given the Jonasdottir estimates were specifically for C. finmarchicus, the values based on prosome length only overestimate the ones from segmentation by more than x2
ggplot(uvp6_seg, aes(x = biovolume_mm3_annotated, y = prosome_volume_Jonasdottir)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline()

ggplot(uvp6_seg, aes(x = biomass_mgC_biovol_annotated, y = prosome_mgC_Jonasdottir)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline()

# Compare lipidfullness calculated from area vs carbon mass
# LF is higher when calculated from carbon mass since lipids are more carbon dense
ggplot(uvp6_seg, aes(x = lipid.lf.area, y = LF_mgC_biovol_annotated)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline()


# Does lipid fullness relate to overall size?
ggplot(uvp6_seg, aes(x = prosome_major_annotated, y = lipid.lf.area)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")

# Compare minor axis from ellipse or if derived from area/major
ggplot(uvp6_seg, aes(x = prosome_minor_annotated, y = minor_derived)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline()

ggplot(uvp6_seg, aes(x = biovolume_mm3_annotated, y = biovolume_mm3_annotderived)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline()
```

For now: assume that best approach is the biovolume from the segmented prosomes using conversion factor average of the three Calanus species

# 2. Calculate abundance and biomass concentration
Simply count by 5m bins (Depth_5m) and divide according to Sampled_volume_L
```{r}
# Clean the data for now and assume best estimates
uvp6_now <- uvp6_seg %>% 
  select(object_id, 
         prosome_mass = biomass_mgC_biovol_annotated,
         lipid_mass = lipid_mass_mgC,
         lf.area = lipid.lf.area,
         lf.mass = LF_mgC_biovol_annotated) %>% 
  # # exclude samples which likely underestimated the prosome biomass?
  # filter(lf.mass < 90) %>%
  
  # Add metadata of each image
  left_join(uvp6_meta %>% 
              select(object_id, sample_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3,
                     depth = object_depth_min,
                     lon = object_lon,lat = object_lat,
                     date = object_date, time = object_time),
            by = "object_id")

AA <-  uvp6_now %>% 
  distinct(sample_id, date, lon, lat, Depth_5m)

# Sample totals at 5m bins
uvp6_5mbin <- uvp6_now %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, date, lon, lat, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3) %>% 
  summarise(abundance  = n(),
            prosome_mgC = sum(prosome_mass),
            lipid_mgC = sum(lipid_mass),
            lf.area.mean = mean(lf.area),
            lf.area.sd = sd(lf.area),
            lf.mass.mean = mean(lf.mass),
            lf.mass.sd = mean(lf.mass),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance / Sampled_volume_m3,
         prosome_mgC_m3 = prosome_mgC / Sampled_volume_m3,
         lipid_mgC_m3 = lipid_mgC / Sampled_volume_m3)


# average to 50 m bins
uvp6_50mbin <- uvp6_5mbin %>% 
  mutate(Depth_50m = floor(Depth_5m / 50)*50+25) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, date, lon, lat, Depth_50m) %>% 
  summarise(abundance = sum(abundance),
            Sampled_volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            abundance_m3 = mean(abundance_m3),
            prosome_mgC_m3 = mean(prosome_mgC_m3),
            lipid_mgC_m3 = mean(lipid_mgC_m3),
            lf.area.mean = mean(lf.area.mean),
            lf.mass.mean = mean(lf.mass.mean),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Add total "Copepoda" information
  left_join(uvp6_ecopart_50m,
            by = join_by(sample_id, Depth_50m)) %>% 
  # Calculate fraction of abundance
  mutate(frac.abund = abundance_m3 / cope_abundance_m3) %>% 
  # Convert depth bin to factors for plots
  mutate(Depth_50m = factor(Depth_50m)) %>% 
  # Add factor lat bins
  mutate(Lat_bin = factor(floor(lat)))
```

# 3. Plot distributions
UVP6 Darkedge: October 12-27, 2021
UVP6 Amundsen: August 13-September 22, 2023
```{r}
# Plot depth distributions
ggplot(uvp6_50mbin, aes(x = Depth_50m, y = lipid_mgC_m3)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  xlab("Depth (50 m bins)") + 
  ylab("Lipid concentration (mgC/m3)")


ggplot(uvp6_50mbin, aes(x = Depth_50m, y = prosome_mgC_m3)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  xlab("Depth (50 m bins)") + 
  ylab("Biomass concentration (mgC/m3)")

  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  xlab("Depth (50 m bins)") + 
  ylab("Lipid fullness (% Prosome area)")


ggplot(uvp6_50mbin, aes(x = Depth_50m, y = lf.mass.mean)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  xlab("Depth (50 m bins)") + 
  ylab("Lipid fullness (% Prosome mass)")


ggplot(uvp6_50mbin,  
       aes(x = Depth_50m, y = lipid_mgC_m3/abundance_m3)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  xlab("Depth (50 m bins)") + 
  ylab("Lipid content of individiual (mgC/indiv)") 

# FOR now only show the trends for Dark Edge
# By latitude bins (removed 68 and 72 lat from Baffin Bay)
ggplot(uvp6_50mbin %>% filter(Lat_bin %in% c(75,76,78)), 
       aes(x = Depth_50m, y = abundance_m3)) +

ggplot(uvp6_50mbin %>% filter(Lat_bin %in% c(75,76,78)),  
       aes(x = Depth_50m, y = lipid_mgC_m3)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  xlab("Depth (50 m bins)") +

  facet_wrap(~Lat_bin)


ggplot(uvp6_50mbin %>% filter(Lat_bin %in% c(75,76,78)),  
       aes(x = Depth_50m, y = lf.area.mean)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  xlab("Depth (50 m bins)") + 
  ylab("Lipid fullness (% Prosome area)") +
  facet_wrap(~Lat_bin)


ggplot(uvp6_50mbin %>% filter(Lat_bin %in% c(75,76,78)),  
       aes(x = Depth_50m, y = lipid_mgC_m3/abundance_m3)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
```
